title: Rob Reinhardt's recent visit to "Atlanta" (apparently Atlantis)

tellings.quote: dear friend Rob Reinhardt that recently visited Atlanta, who

plain: A friend of the researcher Randall Carlson, a man named Rob Reinhardt, recently visited a place Carlson calls "Atlanta", apparently meaning Atlantis, the legendary sunken island. Carlson mentions it only in passing, and his remark breaks off before he says where the place was or what Reinhardt found there.
